requirements.description: A student signs in with a one-time four-digit code sent to their email address; the system does not store passwords.
requirements.acceptance: Request a code for student@example.com and see a sent confirmation. A correct code logs in; a wrong or expired code is refused; requesting another code within 60 seconds is refused.

requirements.description: A signed-in student can create a categorized post about a course or university study topic.
requirements.acceptance: Submit a title, category, and message; the new post appears in the discussion list. An empty required field is rejected.

requirements.description: A student can open a discussion post and read its replies.
requirements.acceptance: Open a post and see its title, category, message, and replies; an unknown post shows a not-found message.

requirements.description: A student can search the shared study resources by keyword.
requirements.acceptance: Search for Java and see matching Java study materials while unrelated resources are hidden.

requirements.description: A student can view another student's profile with their courses and study interests.
requirements.acceptance: Open the sample student profile and see their courses and study interests; an unknown student shows a not-found message.

requirements.description: Every main screen can be used on a phone about 390 pixels wide without horizontal scrolling.
requirements.acceptance: Open each main screen at 390 pixels wide; no horizontal scrollbar or cut-off text appears and every button can be reached.

requirements.description: A search with no matching study resources shows a clear empty-results message.
requirements.acceptance: Search for xyz-no-match-123; no resource cards are shown and a message explains that no results matched.

requirements.description: The resource search returns its response within two seconds for a list of up to 500 resources on the university network.
requirements.acceptance: Run the same search ten times against 500 sample resources on the university network; each response takes under two seconds.

requirements.description: A student can create a study group, browse groups, and join a group for a course.
requirements.acceptance: Create a group for Database Systems, find it in the group list, and join it; submitting a blank group name is refused.

requirements.description: A member of a study group can read and send messages in that group's chat.
requirements.acceptance: As a group member, send a message and see it in the group's message list; a non-member cannot send a message.

requirements.description: The server never returns a student's email verification code in API responses or application logs.
requirements.acceptance: Request and verify a code, then inspect responses and application logs; the four-digit code appears in neither.
